firstLines: Financial analyst with five years in FP&A at logistics and manufacturing companies. I build the forecasts and
models that pricing, budget and capital decisions are made on, and explain them to people who don't live in
• Own the monthly forecast for a $240M freight division; operating income forecast error fell from 9% to 3%
• Built a driver-based Excel model for fuel and lane pricing that the CFO used to approve a 4% rate increase
• Cut month-end variance reporting from five days to two by pulling data from three systems into one Power BI
• Prepared the capital request for a $6.5M warehouse expansion, with payback, downside and delay cases
• Tracked spending against budget for 11 cost centers and sent plant managers a one-page overrun summary
• Rebuilt the plant headcount model after a reorganization, removing about 40 hours of manual updates per
• Consolidated department submissions for the annual budget into a single file the controller reviewed line by
Queen City Community Bank Charlotte, NC
• Reconciled loan fee accounts each week and wrote up the three largest variances for the accounting manager
Bachelor of Science in Finance May 2021
• Coursework: Corporate Finance, Financial Modeling, Managerial Accounting, Econometrics
